name: Tax Report Header 1
definition: Defines message level identification, number of individual tax reports and tax authority.

NumberOfTaxReports.name: Number Of Tax Reports
NumberOfTaxReports.definition: Number of TaxReports in this message. Seller can send all TaxReports in the same file.

TaxAuthority.name: Tax Authority
TaxAuthority.definition: Party to which the TaxReport is delivered. This message block contains party details for a specific tax authority.
